origine_fr: Une main 寸 sous 巳. Autrefois 導 : la main et la route 道, qui donnait aussi le son. La main qui montre la route : guider, conduire.
origine_en: A hand 寸 under 巳. It used to be 導: the hand and the road 道, which also gave the sound. A hand showing the way: to guide, to lead.

phrase.pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyóu shuō de hěn qīngchu.
phrase.en: This guide explains things very clearly.
